title: Nonnegative finite torsion Tate twists
statement: Let $T$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], let $N\in\mathbb N$ and let $A$ be a commutative ring killed by $N$. On the small etale site [def-weil-pbc-etale-site], the roots-of-unity sheaf $\mu_{N,T}$ [def-asd-etale-roots-of-unity] has its unique $\mathbb Z/N$-module structure given by exponentiation. With constant sheaves [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf], module sheaves [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], and the sheaf tensor product [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product], define $A_T(1)=\mu_{N,T}\otimes_{(\mathbb Z/N)_T}A_T$, $A_T(0)=A_T$, and $A_T(r)=A_T(1)^{\otimes_{A_T}r}$ for $r\geq1$. These module sheaves may equivalently be encoded by sheaves of $A$-modules through [lem-weil-pbc-etale-constant-ring-module-equivalence].
